body:
Parent: #423. This is a bounded, source-only geography follow-up from the merged #992 research packet. It remains blocked until #423 is completed; its exact subject IDs and baseline input hashes are pinned below.

## Goal

Verify historical names for the exact 53 Slovenia municipality IDs flagged in the #423 packet; the current GURS crosswalk is not evidence that a 2017 Atlas reference name was wrong. Inspect dated official registers appropriate to the packet’s 2017 source/reference vintage; preserve source vintages, aliases and identity history; recommend an ID-preserving correction only where a dated authoritative record supports it; otherwise record the unresolved status and lawful restoration path.

## Acceptance

- Resolve each of the 53 exact IDs individually against date-appropriate authoritative Slovenian records, or record the precise inaccessible/restricted source and restoration request.
- Retain lawful source bytes or restoration instructions, retrieval date, exact whole-file hashes, license/reuse terms, source vintage, method and a per-ID result ledger.
- Distinguish historical official names, current names, transliteration/diacritic changes and source spelling defects.
- Provide an exact sourced engineering handoff if any change is justified, preserving stable Atlas IDs and name history; do not edit shared geography or assert region approval.

## Evidence and limits

The baseline candidate ledger is `data/regional-review/regional-review-d282e62cf0209796/slovenia-name-correction-candidates.csv`; current official crosswalk evidence is in `.../source/gurs-municipal-boundaries.geojson` and `.../source/source-provenance.json`. #423 explicitly classifies all 53 as candidates requiring dated historical validation.

All outcomes are research findings, not geographic approval or authorization to publish/import. Preserve existing packet sources, release pins, identities, and other workers’ evidence.
